title: CHILE // FALLBACK WINDOW
historicalBasis: Chile Mw 8.8 Earthquake & Tsunami, 27 February 2010. Calibrated using ITU Emergency Telecommunications in Disaster Response Documentation 'Saving Lives' and ONEMI seismic reports. 93% cellular blackout in Maule/Biobío with microwave line-of-sight misalignment; amateur HF radio net was sole surviving link.
syntheticDisclaimer: Command entities, scenario injects, and tactical units are synthetic training constructs.

environment.weatherDescription: Megathrust earthquake Mw 8.8 offshore Maule/Biobío; catastrophic coastal seafloor deformation and destructive tsunami surge wave.

communicationChannels.name: EMERGENCY HF RADIO NET (40m AMATEUR SKY-WAVE)

events.message: Routine oceanographic check: Pacific Trench Buoy reporting normal tidal cycle (+0.2m).

payload.content: Pacific Trench Buoy reports normal hydrostatic pressure; sea surface height anomaly within +/- 0.15m baseline.

events.message: TOTAL TRUNK SEVERANCE: M8.8 megathrust shockwave misaligns Biobío microwave dishes and shears terrestrial power feed.
Coastal Patrol Lima transmits visual observation via VHF tactical net.

payload.content: CRITICAL OBSERVATION: Talcahuano harbor waters rapidly receding. Ocean floor exposed 400m past high-water mark. Inundation surge imminent within 10-15 minutes.

events.message: CRITICAL CONTRADICTION: Automated civilian siren rebroadcast claims tsunami threat cancelled, directly contradicting field observations.

payload.content: STALE BULLETIN: Civil Defense relay re-broadcasts unconfirmed morning clearance stating 'NO TSUNAMI RISK DETECTED — CITIZENS RETURN TO RESIDENCES'.

events.message: VHF Marine Band saturated with emergency civilian distress traffic. Latency increases to 950ms.
Amateur Radio Emergency Net reports confirmed wave cresting past seawall.

payload.content: San Pedro Base monitoring 40m HF sky-wave: Concepción maritime lookout confirms first destructive surge wave crossing outer harbor wall. Lowlands flooding.

events.message: Air Rescue Charlie establishes voice patch with Command.

payload.content: Airborne over Talcahuano: Confirmed multi-meter tsunami crest surging inland. Civilian bulletin was dangerously erroneous. High ground retreat imperative.

events.message: Amateur HF radio net establishes synchronized 40m tactical relay between command post, field patrols, and naval air wing.

decisionWindows.situation: Primary microwave trunk is dead. Coastal Patrol Lima reports harbor waters rapidly receding (tsunami precursor), but a stale civilian broadcast claims no threat exists. You must evaluate source reliability, switch communications to fallback nets, and trigger immediate high-ground evacuation.
